name: TREE STANDARD · T10 (2 Oct 2026)
unit: U = one world unit of the tree's layout (layout.js). Every size below is in U unless it says px. A screen prints U × ppu px, where ppu is the pixels per unit at the whole map's home zoom (measured per screen, printed by the page as __mm.ppu()).

box.note: a tradeable's Geiger bar = its box (CLEAN, and inside an opened section). The bar is the biggest thing on the screen (T8). 3.2 : 1, the Hub's bar.
box.rule: the box prints at its world size × ppu; it grows to the 60 × 19 px floor only where its slot allows: a printed box is never wider than 0.92 × the column pitch nor taller than 0.92 × the row pitch, so two boxes never touch (gap ≥ 8 % of the pitch) at any zoom.

pitch.note: siblings sit 104 U apart in a row (8 U of black between boxes), rows 36 U apart (6 U between), sibling blocks 24 U apart, one level of the tree 70 U below the one above; a heading's names block hangs 50 U under its funds; a second row of sections 110 U under the first.

type.bar_to_ticker: a box 30 U tall carries the 15 px ticker when the box prints ≥ 19 px tall and ≥ the ticker's width + 6 px wide
type.print_rule: a ticker prints on its box only when the box is wide enough for the whole word (measured width + 6 px); otherwise it prints at the next zoom step in, never half-drawn. A heading's and a cohort's title always print (they have no box). A step's ticker is painted on the step and reads once the tread is ≥ 30 px wide.

zoom.step: one wheel notch = OrbitControls zoomSpeed 0.9 (×1.2 of the distance)
zoom.box_min: every zoom (the bar always prints, at its world size)
zoom.box_max: the slot's 92 % (a box never grows past its column)
zoom.note: ticker_min_px_box_w = the narrowest box that carries a 4-letter ticker at 15 px (measured 40 px + 6)

clean.note: the whole map of 613 boxes at the home zoom: at most 76 % of the canvas empty black (T9: 81 %); at least 250 boxes per million px² of canvas

section.note: one section opened (Technology, 126 boxes): at most 86 % black (T9: 88.6 %)

podium.note: the staircase: at most 55 % black (T9: 48 % at 1920)

targets.rule: big enough to read across the room, small enough that 613 boxes do not touch: every box keeps ≥ 8 % of its pitch as black around it; the ticker comes at the zoom step where the box can carry it; the map fills the canvas to the targets above.

podium.turn: the radius grows RW × 1.04 per turn, so the turns of the stair touch (B = RW × 1.04 / 2π)
podium.drop_cap: one tread (D = 30 U): H is lowered from 260 until the biggest drop between neighbours is ≤ 30 U
podium.pitch_rule: tread = reading × H, the same H above and below zero (the mirror)
podium.mirror: the red half is the green half reflected in the zero plane: its own spiral from the centre with the same A, B, D and RW; a green step stands on the zero plane up to its reading, a red step hangs from the zero plane down to its reading (a step's height IS its reading); the equator at zero is a flat grey band between the two base radii (Alan: 'once it reaches the base towards zero it's flat'); the zero ring at the larger radius
podium.no_reading: a name with no reading keeps coiling down a quarter tread per step after the last red one, grey

label.where: painted on the reading face of the step (the tread of a green step, the underside of a red one) and on its outer face; it moves with the step, no billboard
label.note: type height 18 U = 0.6 of the tread's width

camera.note: 24° shows both snakes (the mirror); 70° (T8/T9's home) shows only the green top with the red half under it — decision for Alan

walk.note: the eye stands 120 U over a green tread; on the red half it is the mirror: 120 U under the reading face, looking down the red snake

section3d.label: the ticker is drawn inside the bar's own quad by the bar shader (CLEAN and the opened section): it is part of the bar and moves with it; no DOM label on a tradeable
